title: Chula AI
tagline: AI agent dedicated to maximizing your on-chain yield potential.
description:
Chula AI is your AI copilot for effortless on-chain portfolio management.

A significant barrier to entry for many in the Web3 space is its steep learning curve. Understanding the differences between DeFi opportunities and identifying the best ones for yield generation can be overwhelming for new users.

As the MVP of your on-chain AI copilot, Chula AI harnesses the power of Coinbase CDP’s AgentKit to deliver the most profitable yield opportunities directly to users. With no technical knowledge or manual effort required, Chula AI automates portfolio management, seamlessly allocating your assets to applications offering the highest yield potential.
how_its_made:
Our project is built on top of Coinbase CDP’s AgentKit, enabling users to manage their portfolios seamlessly using natural language. While leveraging the existing capabilities of AgentKit, we’ve introduced two key innovations:

	1.	Optimized Yield Discovery: We’ve added a new feature that identifies the best on-chain yield opportunities tailored to your current portfolio. As part of our MVP, we support Aave and Aerodrome, allowing users to access the most rewarding options effortlessly without any additional manual work.

	2.	User-Friendly Chat Interface: We’ve developed an intuitive chatbox that simplifies interactions with the agent. Users can communicate in natural language, making portfolio management accessible even without technical expertise.
